description: This script manages scheduling of system reboots using cron jobs based on maintenance window times, device properties, and randomization within specified boundaries. It sources configuration files, calculates a randomized reboot time within specified constraints, and updates the cron table accordingly.

methods.name: calcRebootExecTime
methods.description: Calculates a randomized reboot time within maintenance window constraints, considering device offset and time zone differences.

methods.name: ScheduleCron
methods.description: Updates the crontab to schedule a reboot at the calculated randomized time and ensures only one such job exists.
